quest.title: Mutual Exchange
quest.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship...?
quest.rewards_formatted: Sharp Arrowhead x1, Firm Arrowhead x2

talks.objective: Talk to the other hilichurl willing to make conversation

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Tomo tomo. Tomo dala si? Domu nye, ika nye.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Ye muhe dala? Mimi mani ye.

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Ya tomo mani, mani yaya tome nye... Mi muhe du, du <color=#00E1FFFF>lata boya sada</color> si.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: It appears to want something... Oh, I think there's something about this in my handbook, why not take a look?

talks.objective: Give an item to the hilichurl

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Mosi mita, yoyo tomo, mimi tomo.

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Odomu tomo zido mi! <color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>... Feels like we've heard this before. Maybe it'll be in the handbook?

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Domu movo si, Eleka nini si, tomo tomo. Tomo dala si?

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Families change, tribes die out. And friends... Does friendship mean nothing!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just gave the wrong item, it's no big deal... No need to give up on the whole world.

dialogues.speaker: Pensive Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Mi muhe du, du <color=#00E1FFFF>lata boya sada</color> si.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe, time to go dish out some hilichurl justice!
